source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.1, data build 995, released 2026-10-16

data.summary: **[Acrobatic Escape](vsdata:ability/imperial-agents.callidus-assassin.acrobatic-escape)** lets an engaged Callidus Assassin fall back up to D6" when the Fight phase ends. Once the opposing turn ends, it can enter Strategic Reserves if every enemy unit is farther than 3" away. It must return by ingress in your next Movement phase, even on turn one. **[Reign of Confusion](vsdata:ability/imperial-agents.callidus-assassin.reign-of-confusion)** lets the Callidus Assassin add 1CP to an enemy Stratagem once per turn if it targets one of that opponent’s units within 12" of the Callidus Assassin. The **[Neural Shredder](vsdata:wargear/imperial-agents.neural-shredder)** gains [BLAST 2] and loses [PRECISION]. Its profile has a 12" range, D6 attacks, Strength 5, AP −2 and Damage 1, with no Ballistic Skill. It also retains [TORRENT] and [ANTI-INFANTRY 2+].
